cohort: Pregnant women with singleton pregnancies who delivered at Maharaj Nakorn Chiang Mai Hospital, Thailand, between January 2002 and December 2012: 1350 with GDM and 20421 with low-risk pregnancies
finding: Adverse pregnancy outcomes, including fetal macrosomia, cesarean delivery, and pregnancy-induced hypertension, were significantly higher among women with GDM despite the implementation of a GDM practice guideline.
